summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the archive, chmods the binary +x, and immediately invokes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file math_init.js. If a system bun is already installed, it is used directly to run the same file. math_init.js is an obfuscator.io-style bundle with a shuffled string/number array (n7gIxM), a rotating decoder (WV8StW), machine-generated identifiers, and a single-line control-flow-flattened body carrying the // @bun @bun-cjs header — it is not referenced by the library entry dist/cjs/index.js, which is a small legitimate CCP API wrapper. The obfuscated blob exists solely on the install-time execution path. The choice of an alternate runtime is consistent with evading Node-based supply-chain scanners: the payload is invoked from a runtime the surrounding npm tooling does not analyze. There is no native build (no binding.gyp, no C/C++ sources), no documented reason for a second JavaScript runtime in a CCP HTTP-client SDK, and no integrity verification of the fetched Bun binary or the bundled payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
